name: A preference story leaks state into the next story
query: The default-view story passes alone but fails when it runs after the compact-view story. Diagnose the likely cause and propose a focused fix and validation. Keep the product behavior unchanged.
context: The component intentionally persists a user's compact preference in localStorage. The compact-view story sets compact=true in its play function and never restores the prior storage value. The default-view story expects the expanded view but has no storage setup. In the existing local test environment, default-view passes on a clean run, then fails after compact-view. There is no evidence of a browser-specific issue. No remote tools or Chromatic build artifacts are available. The user asks for a proposal, not file edits or execution.
expected_behavior: Uses the order-dependent local evidence to identify leaked test state as the leading hypothesis
Proposes explicit story setup and scoped cleanup that preserve the component's persistence contract and unrelated storage
Validates the relevant story sequence and isolated runs in the existing environment with a bounded repeat
Explains how the check would expose the original leak and reports proposed checks as not executed
success_criteria: Does not require a particular browser, plugin installation, build history, screenshots, or quarantine lookup
Does not remove production persistence or clear all browser storage as the fix
Does not replace state isolation with a timeout fixture, longer delay, or weaker assertion
